caption: "Given a circuit and a shot count, return counts" — the whole contract, nothing more.

code:
def run_bell_experiment(backend,
    shots=1024) -> dict:
  qc = build_bell_pair()
  return backend.run(qc, shots=shots)

# CI / local dev:
run_bell_experiment(
  LocalSimulatorBackend(seed=42))
# Production, zero changes:
run_bell_experiment(
  IBMHardwareBackend("ibm_brisbane"))
caption: Because run_bell_experiment never imports a concrete backend directly, swapping it is a one-line change at the call site.
